units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26">Ex. R. s. 26</cite> (ref to <cite ref="Exodus 17:5">Ex. XVII, 5</cite>) <he>עבור על ח׳ שלהם</he> pass over (ignore) their misconduct; (Yalk. ib. 262; Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 6 <cite ref="H00581"><he>חֵטא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> <he>והואיל ומפני ח׳ של אבותיהם וכ׳</he> (not <he>עונותיהם</he>) since Amalek came in consequence of the sin of their fathers (at Rephidim), says He to them, Remember &c. (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 25:17">Deut. XXV, 17</cite>)?—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18">Gen. R. s. 18</cite>, end <he>מאיזו ח׳ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 25">Yalk. Gen. 25</cite> <he>מאיזה טעם</he>) on account of what impropriety of conduct &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>, end <he>מפני ח׳ אחת וכ׳</he> on account of one single misconduct (in making the golden calf) &c.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>תכתב ח׳ שלי וכ׳</he> let my failing be recorded (<cite ref="Yoma 86b">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>סורחני</he>).
